scenario.name: 08-high-rtt
scenario.description: Required scenario 8: increased RTT and constrained bandwidth: four 40 Mbit/s seeders at 150 ms one-way, downloaders at 50 ms (RTT about 400 ms, above the 1 MiB that 4 requests of 256 KiB keep in flight). Compares per-peer request depth 4/8/16 with matching upload slots (decision 0006 follow-up).
